question: which customers keep booking the same shop, like 3 times or more?
golden_sql: SELECT u.name AS customer_name, sd.name AS shop_name, COUNT(b.id) AS visits FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.requester_id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY b.requester_id, u.name, b.shop_id, sd.name HAVING COUNT(b.id) >= 3;
